summary_md: **Fofy ([@Fofy22023989](https://x.com/Fofy22023989/status/2116080053012627731))** introduces **UniMate** (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), one model that animates rigged humanoid, quadruped, bird and fish skeletons from an English text prompt, e.g. making the bundled eagle flap its wings; MIT licensed ([Friedrich-M/UniMate](https://github.com/Friedrich-M/UniMate)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Friedrich-M/UniMate: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2026] UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons

relevance: Text-to-motion for arbitrary rigs is a key building block for agentic 3D animation.
